hooks.command: fish --command 'set --query HERDR_PANE_ID[1] || exit; set --local p $fish_pid; while set p (string replace --regex --filter "^PPid:\s+" "" </proc/$p/status) && test "$p" -gt 1; if test (cat /proc/$p/comm) = claude; _herdr_tab_title (string split0 </proc/$p/cmdline | string join " " | string shorten -m 32); break; end; end'

sh -c 'p=$(cat); if [ -n "$TUIOS_SOCKET" ] && [ -n "$p" ]; then case $p in (*PermissionRequest*) w=330;; (*) w=2;; esac; o=$({ printf "{\"id\":1,\"verb\":\"agent-hook-event\",\"params\":{\"harness\":\"%s\",\"forwarder\":true,\"env\":{" claude-code; s=; for v in TUIOS_AGENT CODEX_THREAD_ID CURSOR_VERSION GROK_SESSION_ID CRUSH_SESSION_ID; do eval "x=\${$v-}"; case $x in ("") ;; (*[!A-Za-z0-9._:/@+=-]*) ;; (*) printf "%s\"%s\":\"%s\"" "$s" "$v" "$x"; s=,;; esac; done; printf "},\"payload_json\":"; printf "%s" "$p"; printf "}}\n"; } | socat -t "$w" -T "$w" - "UNIX-CONNECT:$TUIOS_SOCKET" 2>/dev/null; echo .); o=${o%.}; case $o in (TUIOS-HOOK-OK?*) printf "%s" "${o#TUIOS-HOOK-OK?}"; exit 0;; esac; fi; printf "%s" "$p" | exec tuios agent-hook claude-code --integration 3'

statusLine.command: sh -c 'p=$(cat); if [ -n "$TUIOS_SOCKET" ] && [ -n "$p" ]; then w=2; o=$({ printf "{\"id\":1,\"verb\":\"agent-statusline-event\",\"params\":{\"harness\":\"%s\",\"forwarder\":true,\"env\":{" claude-code; s=; for v in TUIOS_AGENT CODEX_THREAD_ID CURSOR_VERSION GROK_SESSION_ID CRUSH_SESSION_ID; do eval "x=\${$v-}"; case $x in ("") ;; (*[!A-Za-z0-9._:/@+=-]*) ;; (*) printf "%s\"%s\":\"%s\"" "$s" "$v" "$x"; s=,;; esac; done; printf "},\"payload_json\":"; printf "%s" "$p"; printf "}}\n"; } | socat -t "$w" -T "$w" - "UNIX-CONNECT:$TUIOS_SOCKET" 2>/dev/null; echo .); case $o in (TUIOS-HOOK-OK*) ;; (*) printf "%s" "$p" | tuios agent-statusline claude-code --integration 1 >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; if [ -n "$1" ]; then printf "%s" "$p" | sh -c "$1"; exit $?; fi; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$1" ]; then printf "%s" "$p" | tuios agent-statusline claude-code --integration 1 --then "$1"; exit $?; fi; printf "%s" "$p" | exec tuios agent-statusline claude-code --integration 1' tuios-statusline 'bash "$HOME/.claude/bin/statusline.sh"'
